# Sprint Review Template

Review shows what shipped against the sprint goal and captures feedback as tickets. It is a working session with stakeholders, not a slideshow.

Timebox: about 30 minutes per week of sprint length.

---

## Agenda

1. **Goal.** Read the sprint goal. State plainly: met, partly met, or not met.
2. **Demo.** Show working software for each committed item that is done. Use staging or production, not screenshots, where possible.
3. **Acceptance.** For each item, the product owner accepts or rejects against the acceptance criteria.
4. **Not done.** List carryover and the reason for each, in one line.
5. **Feedback.** Capture every piece of feedback as a draft ticket or a note on an existing one.
6. **Look ahead.** Show the likely goal for next sprint and the top of the ready backlog.

---

## Record

```
SPRINT: [number or name]
DATE: [YYYY-MM-DD]
ATTENDEES: [names and roles]

SPRINT GOAL: [text]
RESULT: [met / partly met / not met]

DEMOED AND ACCEPTED
| Ticket | Title | Accepted by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

DEMOED AND REJECTED
| Ticket | Title | Criterion not met | Next step |
|---|---|---|---|

NOT DONE (CARRYOVER)
| Ticket | Title | Reason |
|---|---|---|

FEEDBACK CAPTURED
| Feedback | From | Ticket created or updated |
|---|---|---|

NEXT SPRINT PREVIEW
- Likely goal: [one line]
```

---

## Agent-lane work in review

Demo agent-produced changes the same way as any other. Note in the record which items came from an agent lane so review rework is traceable. Do not single them out in the demo; the acceptance bar is the same.
